title: ShowPlugin
description: You can share your main hand item, off-hand item, armor, or full equipment set in the chat as a hoverable preview using commands.
body:
# ✨ ShowPlugin – Advanced Show System for Minecraft

ShowPlugin allows players to showcase their main-hand item, off-hand item, armor set, or full equipment in chat with an interactive, pause-to-view display.
Perfect for Survival, RPG, and Lobby servers where item sharing matters.

Supports full item details, enchantments, lore, translations, and even intelligent Shulker Box parsing with automatic merging and sorted layout.

[SIZE=6][B]📌 Features[/B][/SIZE]

✔ Display main-hand, off-hand, armor, or all equipment
✔ Clickable messages showing full item details
✔ Reads name, lore, enchantments, and metadata
✔ Smart Shulker Box content parser
✔ Multi-language support
✔ Configurable cooldown
✔ Customizable message format
✔ Tab-completion & permission system
✔ Reload command for config & languages

🛠 Display Commands
/show                  – Show main-hand item
/show offhand          – Show off-hand item
/show armor            – Show armor equipment
/show all              – Show all gear
/show help             – ShowPlugin help page
/show reload           – Reload config & language files

💎 Full Item Information Display

ShowPlugin provides a complete item inspection view including:

🇨🇳 Automatically translated item names (client-sided)

✨ Custom name & lore support

🔮 Full enchantment list with translations

📦 Quantity, item type, metadata

📝 NBT-friendly presentation

Players can simply click the chat message to view item details.

📘 Intelligent Shulker Box Parsing

ShowPlugin automatically inspects Shulker Boxes and organizes their contents:

✔ Automatically detects items inside
✔ Merges identical items
✔ Adds slot index (line numbers)
✔ Neatly arranges rows
✔ Groups by name, enchantments, and custom properties
✔ Fully readable formatted output

Perfect for Survival & RPG servers where storage matters.

⚙️ Configuration Options

All settings can be customized in config.yml:

⏱ Cooldown toggle & duration

🌍 Multi-world display names (aliases)

🕒 Time display format

💬 Custom message formatting

🌐 Select language file (zh_cn, zh_tw, en_us)

🌍 Multi-Language Support

Included language files:

zh_cn – Simplified Chinese

zh_tw – Traditional Chinese

en_us – English

You can switch languages freely in config.

🔧 Permissions
Permission	Description
showplugin.use	Allow players to use display commands
showplugin.reload	Allow reload of config & languages
🧭 Tab Completion Support

ShowPlugin provides complete command suggestions:

offhand

armor

all

help

reload

Players won’t mistype again.

🚀 Perfect for Any Server Type

✔ Survival
✔ RPG / MMO
✔ Lobby / Hub
✔ Skyblock
✔ Factions
✔ Creative servers needing item preview

No dependencies required.
